content: अनध्यायः अनध्ययनम् [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] Not studying, intermission of study; the time when there is or ought to be such intermission, a holiday (˚दिवसः); अद्य शिष्टानध्यायः <ls>U. 4</ls> a holiday (given) in honour of distinguished guests. See <ls>Ms. 2. 105-6</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 103-4</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">105-8</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">117-8</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">126</ls> <ab>&c.</ab>
